Elf_Commoner
Kadugan is a dockworker unloading a boat in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate during Act Three.
“
Should have docked her under one of those cranes and let the pulleys do the lifting.
„
— Kadugan

Involvement

Act Three

Kadugan is on a boat in the Grey Harbour Docks, attempting to unload its cargo together with  Listless. However, the cargo is extremely heavy and he makes his displeasure known to  Bosun Sharley.

Idle banter

  • Bosun Sharley
    Let's get the cargo sorted for unloading. Sprightly, now!
  • Listless
    Some of these crates are heavier than I feel good.
  • Listless
    I think by the rules we're entitled to a break.
  • Kadugan
    He's right. Trust me, I've read the Articles forwards and back.
  • Bosun Sharley
    When do I get a break from your whining?
  • Bosun Sharley
    I'd like to get this tub out of here before they tighten the blockade.
  • Kadugan
    Why not leave the cargo aboard, then? Try for a better price in Waterdeep?
  • Listless
    That's brilliant, Kadugan! You've got my vote!
